name: Adaptive Rem Grid with Physics-Gated Reveals & Ghost Typography
description: Comprehensive responsive architecture pairing a dual-directional viewport-relative rem grid with a curtain-sliding physics loader, Lenis smooth scroll-lock integration, stacked card container insets, spring-driven text clip-masks, and multi-axis ghost typography with slide-triggered re-reveals.
designPhilosophy: Confidently combines luxury athletic club editorial design with mathematically continuous responsive typography. By combining downward media queries (vw-based root font size below 1920px) with JavaScript upward reduction scaling above 1920px, every card, padding, gap, and display font preserves pixel-perfect proportions across 4K displays down to mobile devices. Stacking rounded container cards inside an inset page frame creates an elegant, tactile sense of depth.
appropriateUseCases: High-end athletic academies, private sports clubs, and luxury fitness resorts
Membership clubs, boutique studios, and editorial marketing destinations
Design and architecture studios requiring strict proportional scaling across screens
Editorial storytelling sites featuring stacked dark/light thematic sections
implementationApproach: 1. Dual-Directional Adaptive Rem Grid: Configure root font-size with media queries (0.833333vw <= 1920px, 1.111111vw <= 1440px, 1.5625vw <= 1024px, 4.444444vw <= 640px), and execute a resize handler for screens > 1920px (reduction = ((1920 - innerWidth) / 1920) * 100 * 0.6666; fontSize = 16 - (16 * reduction) / 100). 2. Gated Physics Loader Curtain: Render a full-screen brand-deep curtain with a tennis wordmark and expanding progress track (easeInOutCubic). Lock Lenis and body scroll during loading. Once ready, animate the curtain translateY(-105%) over 850ms, unlock Lenis, and trigger gated entrance springs on hero headline, stacked tagline, and cards. 3. Plain JS Spring Solver: Implement a minimal rAF spring model (v += (-tension * (x - target) - friction * v) * dt; x += v * dt) for interactive cards, modals, and hover micro-interactions. 4. Ghost Typography with Opposing Parallax: Construct display headlines spanning two rows with ghost-colored and ink-colored words. Map section scroll progress to opposing X-axis translations (top-left -3%->3%, top-right 3%->-3%, bottom-left -2%->4%, bottom-right 4%->-3%). Re-fire clip-mask reveals upon slide navigation. 5. Inset Stacked Card Hierarchy: Wrap sections in an inset main frame (0.5rem mobile / 0.75rem desktop) with rounded-card-lg borders, negative overlap margins (e.g., -2.5rem on facilities), and rich chiaroscuro navy-to-surface transitions.
relevantTechnologies: Plain JS Runge-Kutta / Euler Spring Physics Solver
CSS Clip-Path & Overflow Hidden Text Engines
performanceConsiderations: Uses CSS transform and opacity exclusively for all spring and clip reveals, disables hover interactions on touch/mobile devices (<=768px), stops Lenis during modal/loader presentation to eliminate wasted calculation, and uses will-change sparingly on active parallax elements.
accessibilityRequirements: Integrates full focus-visible rings with brand-light accent, traps modal focus with Esc key dismissal, honors prefers-reduced-motion by bypassing curtain transitions and setting instant entrance states, and uses semantic dl, dt, dd for stat metrics.
